mapper.select: SELECT id, regdate, moddate, address, break_time AS breakTime, category, gu_name AS guName, main_menu AS mainMenu, off_days AS offDays, operating_hours AS operatingHours, page_num AS pageNum, parking, phone, price_range AS priceRange, restaurant_name_en AS restaurantNameEn, restaurant_name_ko AS restaurantNameKo, summary_ko AS summaryKo, summary_en AS summaryEn, Image_url1 AS imageUrl1, image_url2 AS imageUrl2, summary, source_type AS sourceType, api_id AS apiId FROM busan_restaurants WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO busan_restaurants ( address, category, gu_name, main_menu, operating_hours, phone, restaurant_name_ko, summary_ko, summary, Image_url1, source_type, api_id, regdate, moddate ) VALUES ( #{address}, #{category}, #{guName}, #{mainMenu}, #{operatingHours}, #{phone}, #{restaurantNameKo}, #{summaryKo}, #{summaryKo}, -- summary에도 동일하게 저장 #{imageUrl1}, 'API', #{apiId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE address = VALUES(address), category = VALUES(category), gu_name = VALUES(gu_name), main_menu = VALUES(main_menu), operating_hours = VALUES(operating_hours), phone = VALUES(phone), restaurant_name_ko = VALUES(restaurant_name_ko), summary_ko = VALUES(summary_ko), summary = VALUES(summary), Image_url1 = VALUES(Image_url1), moddate = NOW()
